captions: Fig. 14.2 Flows for 'wood preservative, inorganic salt, containing Cr, at plant' and its representation in the ecoinvent database (p.142)
reason: In the Werner wood report the 'Flows for ...' figures ARE the unit-process tables: each row is one exchange with the ecoinvent module name, mean value and unit. Fig. 14.2 is exactly this dataset. The material amounts are printed as 'confidential', but the input LIST is complete and explicit (boric acid, chromium oxide, copper oxide, UCTE electricity, tap water, chemical plant) and three amounts are given (rail 2.94E-01 tkm, lorry 4.90E-02 tkm, chemical plant 4.00E-10 unit, waste heat 1.30E-01 MJ). p.141 carries Fig. 14.1 and the introducing text.
